svg.title: Every named major port and 97% of deep-draft ports sit within 5 km of a large-ship route; inland river ports do not

cc:Work.dc:title: Every named major port and 97% of deep-draft ports sit within 5 km of a large-ship route; inland river ports do not
cc:Work.dc:description: Strip plot of distance to the nearest large-ship route for six kinds of site; ports, racons, and VTS areas cluster under 5 km, while inland river ports sit hundreds of kilometers away.
